capabilities: Display a cover image at the top of a note from the cover property
Read the image link from the note's frontmatter
Adjust cover size and spacing via CSS variables and the .cover-container class
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian shows frontmatter properties as metadata and does not render an image referenced there as a visual cover at the top of the note.
summary: Cover renderer that inserts, at the top of a note body, the image whose link is set in a 'cover' note property.
